text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I'm running in the Oka Sho! I'm going to roar through the Classic Tiara tour—but without overdoing it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Except I overdo it and break a bunch of things! Is my Princess☆Power running out of control?! That may be the case, but I can still win!
